title: GPUs to Mars: Full-Scale Simulation of SpaceX's Mars Rocket Engine
summary: SpaceX engineers present at NVIDIA's GPU Technology Conference on a multi-physics code that simulates the full-scale Raptor methane engine. It covers GPU-based turbulent combustion modeling with adaptive grids and wavelet compression.
why: HN points to it as evidence of SpaceX's serious simulation capability and as a showcase of GPU compute for CFD.

quote.text: This talk was given at NVIDIA GTC 2015 and inspired me to go into manufacturing
